review_method: one AI-assisted read-only inspection pass over the pinned source; no independent human review
span_format: [repository-relative path, exact Python class/function/method qualified name, inclusive first line, inclusive last line]
alternative_rule: Each alternatives entry is one complete proposed evidence option for its area; spans inside an option are jointly required. Unresolved scope is not scored as a definitive reference.
reference_hash_method: sha256(canonical JSON tasks array; sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':'); UTF-8)
